description: Canonical formulas and clamps for the core KPIs tracked in summary.json and downstream dashboards. Changes to any definition require a schema_version bump plus migration notes per ADR-003.

plan_adherence.description: Ratio of completed planner steps to total planned steps.

completed_steps.description: Count of plan steps whose status == "done".

planned_steps.description: Total number of plan steps emitted.

plan_adherence.semver_rule: bump patch for documentation tweaks, minor for additive metadata, major for formula change.

success.description: Weighted aggregate of plan adherence, tool coverage, veto penalty, and outcome score.

veto_penalty.description: Normalized veto impact derived from veto_count / steps.

notes: Weights must sum to 1.0; default set documents Baseline META pipeline.
success.semver_rule: bump major when weights change or clamp adjusted.

tool_coverage.description: Fraction of allowed tools invoked at least once.

tools_allowed.description: Count of tools available in the orchestrated plan.

tool_coverage.semver_rule: bump major when denominator definition changes.

veto_count.description: Total number of governance veto events with severity >= warning.

governance_events.description: Governance outputs with severity + action metadata.

veto_count.semver_rule: bump minor for inclusive/exclusive boundary changes.
